params.val: blocks major status conditions and confusion for grounded Pokemon; halves Dragon-type move damage against grounded targets

verified against Showdown source (moves.ts mistyterrain condition): onSetStatus blocks status infliction and onTryAddVolatile separately blocks confusion, both gated on the target being grounded; onBasePower halves (x0.5) Dragon-type move damage against a grounded, non-semi-invulnerable defender. Both the confusion-block and the Dragon-type damage halving were missing from the original tag, which only mentioned status conditions.
